ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK and EU consolidated financial sanctions lists, and the domestic Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) watchlist. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory for politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members, and close associates under section 12 of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2017. Registered agents must verify identity using valid government-issued photo identification, assess source of funds, and file suspicious transaction reports under the statutory reporting duty.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies e-Registry portal at https://www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Latin script (English, French, or Bislama); any non-Latin characters must be transliterated into Roman characters. Names must be distinguishable from all existing registered names, must not be confusingly similar, and must not imply a false relationship with the Government of Vanuatu or any licensed financial activity. An International Company name must include a corporate identifier such as Limited, Ltd, Corporation, or Inc. as a suffix.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection issued through the VFSC e-Registry, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal must include a written submission distinguishing the proposed name from existing registrations and, where applicable, written consent letters for any sensitive tokens. The Registrar must issue a determination within 14 business days. If the appeal is refused, the applicant may resubmit a materially distinct variant under a new search (new fee applies) or seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. Name reservations are valid for 30 days and lapse automatically; extension is not statutorily available and a fresh reservation with a new fee is required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are permissible for operational purposes only. The International Companies Act [Cap 222] mandates a physical registered office in Vanuatu maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent under the International Companies and Trust Service Providers Act 2017. Remote game-asset rendering, cloud-based collaboration, and overseas 3D-art delivery are fully compatible with the International Company structure; no local physical establishment beyond the agent's registered address is required for ISIC 7490.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: less than 15% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection absent adverse AML intelligence, regulatory complaints, or suspicious transaction reports. The VFSC and VFIU retain full statutory inspection powers, and the licensed registered agent's premises remain subject to periodic compliance audits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), ss. 7-12 (incorporation), s. 30 (share capital), s. 43 (registered office and registered agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Division (Companies Registry)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form IC-1) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital or paid-up capital requirement; the International Company must maintain a VFSC-licensed registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu; shares may be issued of no par value in any currency; no escrow account is mandated
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the registration of the Company as an international company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is ratified, and the registered agent is directed to file the executed Constitution and Form IC-1 with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED, that the subscriber is allotted 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value for USD 1,000, fully paid. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at the licensed agent's address in Port Vila. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed as Director and [Name] as Corporate Secretary, each to serve until removed. RESOLVED, that the Directors are authorized to open bank accounts, define signatories, and engage auditors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) licensed agent roster; corporate services providers in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent engagement letter designating the licensed agent to act as statutory agent and provider of the registered office address. The agent will perform customer due diligence and prepare the incorporation file; no statutory filing occurs until the agent is formally appointed.
required_dossiers: Engagement letter signed by the intended beneficial owner
Certified copy of passport of each proposed director and shareholder
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within 3 months)
Bank reference letter
KYC source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent queries KYC documentation, resubmit certified copies; a clean bank reference may cure source-of-funds concerns; alternate VFSC-licensed agent can be engaged without loss of filing position.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitution and Consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent acting as incorporation preparer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution) in the VFSC prescribed form, including the company name approved by the Registry, registered office clause, share structure, and objects permitting ISIC 7490 digital and creative services. Obtain executed consents from the subscriber, directors, and secretary.
required_dossiers: Executed Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
Form IC-1 Application for Registration of an International Company
Consent to act as director for each appointee
Consent to act as secretary
Certificate of name reservation (if applied separately)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC rejects a name or clause, revise the Constitution and re-submit through the agent; no additional government fee is charged for a single corrective re-filing of clerical defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Application to VFSC Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, International Companies Division (Port Vila)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges Form IC-1, the executed Constitution, consents, and the government filing fee via the VFSC online portal or physical counter submission. The Registrar examines statutory compliance of the proposed name, objects, and agent appointment.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 duly signed
Executed Constitution
Director and secretary consents
Registered agent confirmation letter
Government filing fee receipt (USD 300)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition letter, respond in writing within 14 calendar days amending the identified provisions; unpaid fees are settled within 5 business days; failure to respond results in withdrawal and re-application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and assigns the International Company registration number. The company is deemed incorporated as of the certificate date; the agent then delivers the certificate and statutory registers to the board.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Certified copy of the registered Constitution
Statutory registers (register of directors, members, and charges)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error, submit a written request for certificate amendment with supporting evidence; VFSC issues a corrected certificate within 3 business days without substantive re-examination.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company; banking institution (e.g., licensed Vanuatu bank or correspondent bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass the first board resolution to ratify incorporation, allot shares, establish the registered office, and appoint officers. Issue share certificates, open corporate bank accounts, and, if a physical studio is established, apply for the municipal business licence and employer registration.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
First board resolution
Share certificates and register of members
Corporate bank account application and signatory identity documents
Municipal business licence application (if physical office established)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires enhanced due diligence, provide a corporate structure chart, contract copies with clients, and a declaration of economic substance; if the municipal council disputes the use-class, apply for a change of use certificate or select a licensed commercial premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 7490 digital creative services; general business licensing of the Port Vila Municipal Council (PVMC) applies only where a physical studio or office is operated
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating permit required; optional Municipal Business Licence (Port Vila Municipal Council) for physical premises hosting the 3D art studio

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change and Meteorology
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-based creative services are not listed under Schedule 1 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations; a preliminary environmental assessment (PEA) or full EIA report is not required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge or VOC emission thresholds are triggered for computer-based 3D art operations; sanitary wastewater is discharged to municipal sewerage per the Waste Management and Pollution Control Act [Cap 283]; electronic waste and printer consumables must be handled through approved recyclers

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection and clearance certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Services; Certificate of Occupancy and structural load inspection from the municipal building authority for leased commercial premises; workplace registration and occupational safety verification with the Vanuatu Department of Labour for all employees

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), a department of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official government portal: https://www.gov.vu; VRC service portal: https://www.vrc.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned International Company (IC): (1) incorporate under the International Companies Act Cap 191 through a licensed agent registered with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation; (2) file the registered office, director, and shareholder particulars with the VFSC registry; (3) apply to the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) using the prescribed TIN application form, supported by the Certificate of Incorporation, certified passport copies of beneficial owners, and proof of the registered agent address; a non-resident IC with no physical place of business in Vanuatu may appoint a local tax agent to file the application; (4) if annual taxable turnover attributable to Vanuatu exceeds VT 5,000,000, file the VAT registration application simultaneously. No income tax registration is required because Vanuatu imposes no national corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None comparable to US check-the-box. Under the International Companies Act Cap 191, an IC is statutorily tax-exempt and automatically treated as non-domiciled; it cannot elect to be taxed as a Vanuatu-resident company. The Value Added Tax Act Cap 247 permits voluntary VAT registration for turnover below the compulsory threshold, but no hybrid mismatch elections, entity classification elections, or income tax grouping mechanisms exist under Vanuatu law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) governed by the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998 (Cap 247) and the Value Added Tax Regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (five million Vatu) annual taxable turnover; a supplier making taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceeding this threshold in any 12-month period must register for VAT; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold; exports of goods and offshore services are zero-rated and count toward the threshold for registration purposes
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or mandatory e-invoicing regime. Vanuatu does not operate a government e-invoicing platform, an API-based transaction clearance system, or an SOVD/digital stamping requirement. Suppliers must issue paper or electronic tax invoices containing prescribed particulars under the VAT Regulations (supplier name, TIN/VAT registration number, date, description of supply, taxable amount, and VAT charged) and retain records for seven years for inspection by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Schedule 2 of the VAT Act Cap 247, 0% VAT applies to: (a) goods physically exported from Vanuatu by the supplier, evidenced by customs export entries and shipping documents; (b) services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and who consumes the benefit wholly outside Vanuatu, including digital 3D art creation, modelling, sculpting, animation, and character rigging services delivered electronically to overseas game publishers; (c) services directly connected with exported goods; and (d) international transportation of passengers or goods. The supplier must retain contemporaneous documentation proving the recipient's non-residence, the offshore place of consumption, and, for goods, physical export from Vanuatu within the statutory record-keeping period.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Vanuatu Customs Export Declaration (electronic entry lodged in ASYCUDA World)
Bill of Lading or House Airway Bill evidencing physical export out of Vanuatu
Commercial invoice and signed service or licensing agreement with the non-resident client
Inward remittance credit advice or bank statement evidencing receipt of foreign-currency payment
Valid VAT tax invoice issued under the VAT Act Cap 247
Written declaration or certificate from the non-resident client confirming non-residence and exclusive offshore consumption
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs may conduct retrospective VAT assessments within the seven-year record-keeping window. Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims attract a default assessment of up to 200% of the VAT evaded, additional monetary penalties and interest under the VAT Act Cap 247, and criminal liability including fines and imprisonment on indictment. An International Company found to have traded with Vanuatu residents or to have claimed zero-rating without contemporaneous export documentation forfeits its statutory tax-exempt status, becomes retrospectively liable for VAT and penalties, and may be struck off by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission for non-compliance.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) acting jointly with the Minister of Finance under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP 125] and the Exchange Control Act [CAP 61]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises corporate registration, licensing, and financial services conduct.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is a managed float currency with full convertibility for current-account transactions and broad de facto liberalization of capital-account movements for non-resident-owned International Companies. Profit remittance and dividend distribution to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted and tax-free under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and the zero-income-tax regime, provided the underlying balance is verified through standard bank source-of-funds and sanctions screening. Practical hurdles are operational rather than regulatory: VUV is not an internationally traded hard currency, so most cross-border settlement occurs through liquid channels in USD, AUD, NZD, or EUR. Multi-currency operating accounts and offshore USD clearing accounts are permitted and commonly used.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender, mandatory conversion ratio, or repatriation timeline exists under Vanuatu law. Export earnings from game art outsourcing services may be retained freely in any convertible currency, held in domestic or offshore bank accounts, and remitted abroad at will. On an ex gratia basis, a purely documentary purpose code advising the nature of the inward remittance is required by the receiving authorized dealer; ICs may maintain revenues in USD or AUD with zero mandatory conversion to VUV.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-Currency Operational Account (USD/AUD/NZD/EUR/VUV) plus segregated Capital Escrow Account
USD-denominated Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account for non-resident ICs

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Ltd
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account in AUD/USD/VUV with sweat equity support for small-cap ICs
Local VUV Settlement and Payroll Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low with legal constraints. PayPal is accepted and viable for low-value client invoices and micro-settlements in USD from North American and European game studios; however, PayPal's Vanuatu platform limits high-volume B2B flows and may impose aggregate account ceilings. Global digital EMIs (Wise, Revolut, Mercury) generally do not service Vanuatu-domiciled entities because VUV lacks international convertibility and the jurisdictions classify Vanuatu ICs as offshore low-tax entities requiring enhanced due diligence. It is legally permissible but operationally impractical for the IC to rely on EMIs as the primary clearing rail; SWIFT banking via a Tier 1 authorized dealer remains the contractual and liquidity backbone.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act [CAP 222], Vanuatu authorized dealers normally require at least one natural-person director or a designated senior officer holding a valid power of attorney to attend a physical or video-conference interview with relationship compliance. Fully remote digital onboarding without an in-country introducer is not accepted by ANZ, Bred, or BSP. A practical hybrid is accepted: the beneficial owner appears via video conference before the bank's Port Vila office, with original certified passport and proof of address couriered via the licensed VFSC registered agent, alongside a signed bank reference from an existing international bank of good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of beneficial ownership due to nominee shareholder or bearer-share structures typical of older Vanuatu ICs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Furnish (i) current Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing issued by the VFSC; (ii) a full beneficial ownership chart back to natural persons certified by the licensed registered agent; (iii) certified copies of the register of members and directors prepared under the International Companies Act; and (iv) an AML/CFT declaration executed by the ultimate shareholder confirming non-involvement of politically exposed persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for initial capital injection from a holding company or sister entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a board resolution of the transferring entity, a formal subscription letter stating the contribution is for working capital, audited or management accounts of the upstream shareholder, and bank statements evidencing the legitimate accumulation of funds from operating revenue of the 3D art outsourcing group.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry red-flag segmentation treating creative BPO as potential front for IP royalty tunneling
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit executed client master service agreements and work orders with named AAA game publishers, sample invoices and delivery receipts for completed 3D assets, a registered IP assignment/revenue-share agreement, and a written service-rendering narrative showing geographical and substantive delivery of digital art services from Vanuatu contracting entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Atypical payment patterns or partial refunds between the IC and overseas subcontractors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a contractor ledger with signed NDAs and freelance agreements, supporting invoices for each outbound payment, and a bank-supported process where net payroll and subcontractor settlements are traced to conclusively identified 3D artists and riggers; where refunds occur, provide client-issued credit notes cross-referenced to revised statements of work.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: Inbound wires from the ultimate shareholder or an intra-group financing entity arrive at the Vanuatu IC's segregated USD capital account via SWIFT, with remittance information stating 'Capital Contribution / Equity Subscription' plus the IC registration number; the authorized dealer accepts purpose code 'GIF' (grants/investment-fund transfer) or BPM6 equivalent for direct investment equity. For loan funding, a written intercompany loan agreement with an OECD-compliant arm's length rate must be filed with the bank. Where the transfer exceeds the bank's monitoring threshold, the bank requests the evidentiary defense dossier listed above, and funds are credited only after clearing the OFAC/EU sanctions screen and confirming no cryptocurrency intermediary is involved.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is the SWIFT MT103 for high-value salary payments, subcontractor disbursements, and licensing fees to artist studios worldwide; for large-scale milestone-based procurement of specialized assets and on-premise outsourcing from partner studios, a Commercial Letter of Credit (documentary credit issued under UCP 600 through ANZ or Bred with sight drafts) provides settlement security. For low-value non-institutional payments to individual freelance contractors, USD-denominated PayPal and its withdrawal to the Vanuatu bank account serve as a supplementary micro-clearing rail. All outbound wires must carry a truthful purpose description, a valid SWIFT beneficiary account, and must be processed without conversion into VUV when held in the corresponding USD/AUD multi-currency account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable forward FX contracts in VUV/USD and VUV/AUD transacted through an RBV-licensed authorized dealer with maturity customized up to 12 months for confirmed invoice exposure
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV contracted with an international counterparty where onshore deliverable liquidity is insufficient
Cross-currency swaps in USD/AUD or USD/EUR executed through an authorized dealing bank to match the IC's receivable currency profile against USD-denominated disbursements

Natural-hedge and multi-currency set-off arrangements under which client invoices are denominated exclusively in USD or AUD, with operational liabilities re-denominated to the same currency to minimize residual FX open position

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Renewal (Government Fee) Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) / Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for each calendar year of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs administrative monetary penalties; continued non-payment for consecutive renewal cycles triggers strike-off and dissolution by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Client Due Diligence Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (retained on behalf of the International Company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the renewal date and within 30 days of any shareholding transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit accurate UBO confirmation to the Registered Agent may result in refusal of the renewal application, regulatory reporting violations, and service suspension by the agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit requirement for a standard Vanuatu International Company; a voluntary audit may be required by the company's constitutional documents, shareholder resolution, or as a condition of a VFSC-licensed financial services activity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) is the common benchmark for any voluntarily prepared financial statements; Vanuatu does not prescribe a mandatory statutory accounting framework for International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The VFSC-licensed Registered Agent must collect, verify, and record up-to-date beneficial ownership details at each renewal cycle and upon any change in shareholding or constitutional documents. Vanuatu does not maintain a public UBO register, but the Registered Agent must retain the information on file and provide it to VFSC upon lawful request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 3,000 per engagement if an independent audit is voluntarily procured

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (zero-rate) - Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax at the national level, and an International Company ('IC') registered under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 is expressly exempt from all Vanuatu taxes on international business income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective tax rate is 0% for offshore B2B game-art outsourcing; there is no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, no estate duty and no exchange control. The only annual tax-type charge is the fixed VFSC International Company annual government fee (tiered by authorized capital, approximately US$300-US$1,500), which is not profit-linked. A 12.5% value-added tax applies only to domestic supplies in Vanuatu; export of 3D art services to non-resident game studios is outside the scope of VAT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for a Vanuatu IC. The mandatory annual compliance equivalents are: (1) IC Annual Return filed through the licensed registered agent on the VFSC e-registry portal (International Companies module); (2) if the IC carries on an economic-substance relevant activity, the ESR Annual Notification and ESR Annual Return filed through the VFSC Economic Substance portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: IC Annual Return: no later than one calendar month after the anniversary of incorporation. ESR Annual Return: no later than 12 months after the end of the IC's financial year (financial year end commonly 31 December).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, IC registration number, incorporation date, anniversary date, registered agent code, registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must provide a valid service-of-process address and email; no Vanuatu tax identification number is issued because no income tax account is maintained for the IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: IC AR - Capital and shareholding panel
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, issued shares, share classes, number of shareholders, and a bearer-share status declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any bearer shares must be immobilized with the registered agent; non-resident ultimate beneficial owner details must be current on the VFSC beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration confirming that the company has not transacted business with Vanuatu resident persons, has not owned Vanuatu land, and continues to satisfy the IC Act exemption conditions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A false declaration voids the IC tax exemption. For a game 3D art studio, the IC should only invoice foreign clients; domestic Vanuatu contracts must be segregated into a separately VAT-registered local entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection and description of the relevant activity. A game 3D asset outsourcing studio is classified as 'Service Business' where services are supplied to third-party game developers, or 'Headquarters' if it coordinates regional sub-contracted rendering hubs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classify revenue as 'Service Business' when the 3D art is delivered to external studio clients. The low-risk AML tier does not exempt the IC from the ESR filing obligation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VUV-denominated operating expenditure, number of employees, physical premises description, income attributable to each relevant activity, and confirmation that strategic management decisions were made in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If directors and contractors are offshore, the return must still disclose actual substance; a nil substance declaration materially increases EU listing risk, VFSC scrutiny, and foreign tax authority information-exchange inquiries.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No late corporate income tax penalty exists because no corporate income tax is due. The operative consequences are: VFSC administrative late fees on the IC Annual Return, automatic administrative strike-off for continued non-filing, and ESR penalties for late or non-filed returns including daily penalty increments and potential director disqualification. Reinstatement of a struck-off IC requires payment of all arrears plus a reinstatement fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Registration Application and monthly/quarterly VAT Return filed electronically through the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR) DTRIS online portal. This filing is mandatory only if the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu and exceeds the statutory registration threshold of VUV 4,000,000 in annual taxable turnover.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or quarterly as determined by the VCIR taxable-period assignment.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VAT return and payment due on or before the 21st day of the month following the end of the taxable period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 12.5% VAT charged on taxable supplies made within Vanuatu during the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a pure offshore BPO business, this box is nil. Invoices to foreign game studios should state 'Services performed outside Vanuatu; no Vanuatu VAT applies'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 12.5% VAT recoverable on qualifying local expenditures, such as Port Vila office rent, local software subscriptions, and utilities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign vendor invoices without a Vanuatu VAT registration number do not constitute recoverable input tax credits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: VAT Act Cap. 246 imposes a default surcharge on unpaid VAT plus interest accrual, monetary fines (maximum corporate fine up to VUV 1,000,000 in serious cases), and imprisonment for individual officers who participate in deliberate suppression. The VCIR may issue an assessment for up to three years of unreported output VAT.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no remittance tax, and no branch profits tax. The IC may distribute 100% of retained earnings to non-resident shareholders without domestic statutory withholding or deduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double-taxation-treaty network with the main client markets (United States, EU, Japan, South Korea). The principal bilateral instruments are a Tax Information Exchange Agreement with Australia and limited exchange-of-information arrangements. Because Vanuatu itself levies zero WHT, there is no treaty-relief application portal and no TRC (tax residence certificate) issuance procedure. A foreign payer seeking to evidence the IC's tax status should obtain the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, a registered agent confirmation of IC tax-exempt status, and a notarized annual declaration of beneficial ownership; for U.S. payors, a properly completed Form W-8BEN-E claiming entity classification as a foreign corporation with no U.S. trade or business should be provided.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: royalty WHT 0%; interest WHT 0%. No Vanuatu treaty modifies these rates. The material risk arises on the customer side: foreign payors may apply non-treaty withholding on US-source royalties or local licensing fees (e.g., 30% US withholding on US-source royalty income) unless the contract is structured as a commission for custom-created 3D assets rather than an IP licence fee. Intercompany debt advanced to the IC bears zero Vanuatu WHT, but interest deductibility may be challenged under the payor jurisdiction's earnings-stripping rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None in VUV - Vanuatu has not enacted transfer pricing legislation, Local File/Master File thresholds, country-by-country reporting, or advance pricing agreements. The operative constraint is customer-side: if the client is a US public company or an EU/Japan/Korea taxpayer, that taxpayer must prepare contemporaneous CUP/TNMM documentation for the outsourcing fee. A missing foreign TP file triggers foreign penalties and adjustments irrespective of the zero Vanuatu rate. In practice, the IC should maintain an annual service agreement, cost build-up schedule, and margin benchmark for the 3D art outsourcing fee.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2023 and associated regulations apply to any IC conducting a relevant activity. A 3D art outsourcing studio falls within the ESR 'Service Business' category and must demonstrate in Vanuatu: substantive employees engaged in 3D pipeline roles, a physical office or racking location with production infrastructure, locally incurred operating expenditure, and board minutes documenting strategic and operational management in Vanuatu. Using the IC as a mailbox while all creative and administrative functions are performed through sub-contractors in high-tax jurisdictions breaches ESR, exposes the IC to strike-off, and triggers automatic information exchange with the beneficial owner's tax authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC books material 3D art revenue (e.g., USD 1,500,000 annually) yet maintains zero VUV payroll, no Vanuatu lease agreement, no locally engaged production staff, and no board meeting records evidencing management in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC penalty: ESR annual return rejection, daily administrative penalty accrual, compulsory strike-off upon issuance of a non-compliance certificate, and referral to the EU Code of Conduct Group; reputational listing on public blacklists and exclusion from correspondent banking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false substance declarations face personal director disqualification, civil restoration orders from the VFSC, foreign tax authority information-exchange requests, and ancillary court orders including asset freezes and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC as a pure invoice conduit while the actual 3D art is rendered by related studios in high-tax countries, and undercharging the related studio so that the majority of consolidated profit remains inside the zero-tax VU shell.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Domestic Vanuatu sanctions are minimal because no domestic transfer pricing statute exists, but customer-side consequences are severe: recharacterization under IRC Section 482 or equivalent foreign CFC/GAAR rules, tax adjustment penalties of 25-100% of the underpaid foreign tax, inclusion in the customer's country-by-country report, and potential permanent establishment findings against the foreign related studio.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign revenue authorities may pierce the IC to issue director-level notices and impose personal penalties for false documentation; in egregious cases, mutual legal assistance and extradition procedures can be initiated for criminal tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC uses bearer shares, the non-resident beneficial owner maintains undisclosed PayPal or wire payment rails for 3D art contracts with no KYC file held by the VFSC-licensed agent, or the registered agent is not updated with the new UBO within 14 days of any share transfer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act and VFSC AML rules: regulatory fines against the IC, suspension or revocation of the registered agent's license, freezing of the IC's bank account, and downgrade of the IC's AML risk classification from Low-Risk Standard to High-Risk, which usually results in forced account termination by correspondent banks.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for AML failures: criminal fines, imprisonment, civil restitution for assets laundered through the outsourcing invoices, and travel bans issued pending investigation. Nominated directors face immediate disqualification and potential immigration arrest.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unregistered Vanuatu VAT on Domestic Supplies
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC also contracts with a Port Vila-based developer for local game UI assets, exceeds VUV 4,000,000 annual taxable turnover, and deliberately fails to register for or remit 12.5% VAT while collecting gross payments from domestic clients.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VAT Act Cap. 246: VCIR assessment for unreported output VAT, default surcharge, interest accrual, monetary penalties of up to VUV 1,000,000 for corporations, and criminal prosecution of the managing officer for intentional evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly participate in VAT suppression are jointly and severally liable for the assessed VAT debt; the liability survives corporate dissolution, and a strike-off order will not be issued by the VFSC until the VCIR tax debt is settled.
